published_baseline: Founder-approved #1414 commercial website baseline after the #1128 mobile information-hierarchy hardening and Intelligence score-truth fixes. Ask Geomacro uses mobile-safe word wrapping for long user questions and derived answers/evidence; Bridge/Swap/Liquidity preserve narrow-screen stacking, wrapping and gutters while retaining desktop sizing. /intelligence defaults to Newest so newer verified evidence is not hidden behind an older higher-severity record; Highest risk remains explicitly selectable. Risk-domain summaries show each domain's latest verified score and original evidence date rather than an average that can obscure recency. Current scored rows are labelled Verified current score; quiet or historical scored rows remain Last verified score. Feed refresh time is shown separately from score evidence time, so a continuously checked domain is never falsely presented as having a newly changed score. Macro and Rare Earth expose their latest canonical classifier-scored evidence when present in the verified B2 package. No score, timestamp, source eligibility or freshness is synthesized. Live observations remain separately labelled and unscored until canonical classification. Raw publisher content/provider details remain hidden. /global-risk remains independently hard-pinned by config/global-risk-final-lock.json and its dedicated fail-closed verifier.
policy: Public website presentation is frozen at the founder-approved #1128/#1414 mobile and Intelligence baseline. Intentional website changes require explicit founder approval and a dedicated baseline update. The finalized /global-risk presentation is additionally protected by its independent permanent lock.
